en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of the city of Pécs with hills in the background and an open field with a few people in the foreground. Prominent church towers rise above the cityscape. At the top it is captioned in Hungarian and German. The lower front margin bears a handwritten greeting and signature. The reverse side is printed as a correspondence card in Hungarian and addressed in elegant cursive handwriting, with a postmark from Pécs and a postage stamp.
